definition: to play a tune freely, improvising
description: A small jazz club in a brick-vaulted cellar. A woman with her locs tied up in a knot, wearing a grey satin shirt and black trousers, plays a brass trumpet under a spotlight, a music stand in front of her. She lowers the trumpet, smiles at the man beside her who plays a tall wooden double bass, and then lifts it to her lips again. In the foreground a young man plays a snare drum with brushes. The audience sits at small round tables lit by candles in jars.
